qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Citation-locked research reagent catalog (antibodies, recombinant proteins, ELISA kits, RNAscope spatial biology) with extreme switching costs; researchers cannot swap reagents mid-protocol or in FDA regulatory filings without risking failed experiments and assay invalidation. Supports 2-4% annual catalog price increases and ~67-72% gross margins.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Peak-to-Peak Compounding & Capital Allocation, REJECT). Citation-locked research reagent franchise with strong gross margins (~67-72%) and net cash balance sheet ($65M net cash, 26x interest coverage). However, fails Gate 6 due to an unrepeatable pandemic windfall peak in FY2022 ($2.19 Owner EPS) followed by a 56% peak-to-trough collapse to $0.96 in FY2024. Despite FY2025 rebound to $1.60, earnings remain well below peak. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC is stuck at an inferior 8.7% 10-year median (9.2% 5-year median) due to $1.3B+ in accumulated serial M&A goodwill and write-downs/divestitures (Exosome Diagnostics), proving long-term capital allocation dilution. Pending $73/share cash buyout by Merck KGaA caps independent compounding runway. [5-10Y g: organic reagent/instrument volume 5.0% + catalog pricing 2.0% + gross margin mix 0.5% - M&A integration drag 0.5% + net buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial history shows structural tension between high tangible capital efficiency and serial M&A dilution. Tangible ROIC averaged 45-50%+ (FY2025: 25.0%), but 10-year median GAAP ROIC is only 8.7% (5-year median 9.18%) due to $1,279M in goodwill and intangibles against $2,108M equity. Owner EPS compounded from $0.81 (FY2016) to a peak of $2.19 (FY2022) during the COVID biopharma boom, but plunged 56% to $0.96 in FY2024 amidst customer inventory destocking and biopharma funding contraction before recovering to $1.60 in FY2025. Free cash flow conversion is pristine (FY2025 FCF $222M on $182M Net Income, 122% conversion; TTM 107%). Balance sheet is conservative with $265M cash vs $200M debt ($65M net cash) and 26.2x interest coverage. Management executed multiple tuck-in acquisitions (ProteinSimple, ACD, Asuragen, Lunaphore), but Exosome Diagnostics required divestiture at a loss in FY2025. In June 2026, Bio-Techne agreed to be acquired by Merck KGaA for $73 per share in cash ($11.3B enterprise value).

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
